title: Local decision connected with observation and evidence
scenario: A learner encounters a real-life situation where observation and evidence and scientific explanation pull the decision in different directions. The learner must use evidence and reasoning rather than guesswork.
tasks: Identify the decision to be made.

title: Transfer case: cause and effect
scenario: A new situation resembles an idea from 'The Ever-Evolving World of Science' but includes a different condition. Learners must decide whether the chapter concept still applies.
tasks: Decide what transfers and what does not.
